svg.metadata: Ferrosift retrofit module M01-W1; model-derived HLR and solid sections; geometry mm; A3 landscape; Host interface and experimental exclusion reservation
svg.text: Host interface and experimental exclusion reservation
A nonmetallic window alone does not establish a compatible installation.
SECTION A-A / X42 / actual belt and support stack / 1:5
DETAIL / X42 / stack dimensions listed at right / 1:2
Loaded sag, tolerances and conductive-feature height add uncertainty. No deflection allowance or usable lift-off is validated.
The dashed scene reservation is X -180..480, Y -340..340, Z850..1200. This 660 x
680 x 350 mm box is a test allowance, not a verified electromagnetic exclusion
Measure the actual belt reinforcement, joint, supports, rollers, frame, fasteners and
contamination across the intended frequency range. Retest under load and motion;
Support portal centres: X +/-620, Y +/-420. Slots: 24 x 9. Host hole pattern,
selected fasteners, load paths and permissible deflection remain open.
Upstream masks, compliant skirts and proposed pod guards restrict outer-lane
access. Feed metering must inhibit blocked or off-lane material. Jams, wear,
escape and impact remain untested; no accepted fragment-size limit is implied.
Metal-free packaging is a design intention, not proof of sensing performance. Do
not install on an unknown reinforced belt or assume full-width coverage.
DIMENSIONS: mm | SCALE PER VIEW AT A3 | PROPOSED RESEARCH GEOMETRY
No approved fit, tolerance, load, electromagnetic coverage, throughput or safeguarding rating.
